item.text: The existing parser is a single-pass block parser with a shared `Document` reference map. I’m adding a quote extractor and integrating recursive block parsing at quote boundaries, while keeping reference definitions merged into the outer document.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > commonmark_parser/block_quotes.py <<'EOF'
\"\"\"Block quote marker extraction.\"\"\"

import re

_MARKER = re.compile(r'"'^ {0,3}> ?'"')


def parse_block_quote(lines: list[str]):
    \"\"\"Return consumed lines and quote content, including paragraph laziness.\"\"\"
    if not lines or not _MARKER.match(lines[0].rstrip('\\n')):
        return None
    content: list[str] = []
    consumed = 0
    paragraph_open = False
    for line in lines:
        body = line.rstrip('\\n')
        marker = _MARKER.match(body)
        if marker:
            text = body[marker.end():]
            content.append(text + ('\\n' if line.endswith('\\n') else ''))
            consumed += 1
            if not text.strip():
                paragraph_open = False
            elif not paragraph_open:
                paragraph_open = True
            continue
        if not body.strip() or not paragraph_open:
            break
        content.append(line)
        consumed += 1
    return consumed, content
EOF
"
